design.human_review: No API required. Anonymous per-image edit, subject and artifact review. Missing labels remain pending.

preregistration.primary: All-sample joint success = edit_ok AND subject_ok AND NOT artifact. Report paired task/seed results and per-object summaries.
preregistration.secondary: NCC at fixed ROI and shift-compensated NCC, report shift and common-success paired samples with denominator; no equal-rate subset picking.
preregistration.mechanism: Compare PROJECT_KV to CORR_KV and NORMMATCH_KV. Compare PROJECT_ONLY to CORR100; CORR_V to CORR_KV. If only preservation improves while joint success drops, treat as a trade-off, not decoupling. Compare against fixed CORR75_KV as a simple global attenuation baseline.
preregistration.scope: Development protocol with two seeds per task. External-method comparison and more independent held-out objects follow after this mechanism decision.
preregistration.no_oracle_claim: ETA03 is an internal baseline; no external baseline or eta oracle is implemented in this package.
